text: The bright, modern architecture around me feels almost clinical. The glass walls reflect both the interior light and my own quiet self-doubt. In the company of objects meant for safety—an extinguisher, hoses—there is a sense of preparedness, of waiting for something to happen. I feel slightly out of place, as if the world expects more of me than I am ready to offer. Moving closer to the R+D display, the colors and the displays spark my curiosity. Yet, the words about innovation and coexistence with intelligence remind me how much we strive to understand the unknown. I feel a detached observer, engaged and curious, but not fully at home.
